messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 ALERT - streaming decode nodes in us-west-2 are throwing CUDA OOMs and crashing. metric decode_gpu_oom_rate spiked above threshold. auto-created thread by maria_sre
maria_sre: paging @liam_oncall and @eng-maria. multiple restarts on decode pods, some pods restarted 4x in last 8m. graphs in ops-dashboard look like a sharp tail. any customer reports?
liam_oncall: i'm up. pulling logs now. what was last deploy window?
eng-maria: no deploys in the past hour, nothing obvious in release log. initial hypothesis: workload change. collecting `kvcache` traces and request header samples.
jon_prod: CS flags one large customer seeing streaming 500s and aborted sessions. they show a pattern of very long turn lengths.
maria_sre: from `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep decode` -> several pods on node gpu-g4dn-03 and gpu-g4dn-07 with restart counts 2-5.
liam_oncall: sample from `kubectl logs decode-abc -n inference`:
```
[2026-03-15T18:04:11Z] model: start stream decode
[2026-03-15T18:04:12Z] runtime: KVCache append size now 1.8GB
[2026-03-15T18:04:33Z] runtime: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY while allocating 5.2GB
[2026-03-15T18:04:33Z] container: exit status 137
```
eng-maria: i'm seeing `X-Client-Gen: agent-sdk/0.9` in header samples and a bunch of requests with no `max_tokens` header. that agent version had a bug where it omitted max_tokens for streaming.
jon_prod: CS confirms the enterprise agent is on 0.9 and some of their sessions had unbounded output. they blamed the SDK but want mitigation asap.
maria_sre: that explains the KV growth -> OOM cascade. our runtime expects per-request caps but streaming path's header parsing missed this case.
liam_oncall: mitigation options: 1) hotpatch runtime to enforce a hard token cap at entry 2) apply admission webhook to mutate missing header to 1024 3) throttle at edge (envoy) by per-connection token budget 4) cordon/evacuate older g4 nodes. i can do 2+4 quickly.
eng-maria: do 1 as follow-up; for immediate containment do 2 and 4. webhook is fast. cordon top 3 g4dn nodes and drain.
liam_oncall: applying webhook mutating `max_tokens` to 1024 for streaming requests without header. kubectl patch applied. also `infractl scale --pool decode-usw2 --add-nodes 4` to increase buffer capacity.
deploy-bot: envoy: applying rate-limit config (per-conn token cap 1024) -> canary 1/5 started.
maria_sre: rolling the node drains now: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-g4dn-03` then `kubectl drain ...`
liam_oncall: after webhook + canary envoy, OOM rate dropped from 15% -> 6% within 7m. still seeing a handful of crashes on nodes that haven't been drained yet.
eng-maria: i've also scheduled temporary routing rule to divert sessions from the flagged client agent to `decode-quantized-fallback` which keeps small KV footprint. pushing policy to 15% of their traffic.
jon_prod: CS: reported 28 dropped streaming sessions for that enterprise, they want an RCA. cc @cs-elaine
cs-elaine: emailing them immediate ops note and advising SDK upgrade + temporary caps. will include apology and remediation ETA.
liam_oncall: cordoned and drained 3 old g4dn nodes; pods rescheduled onto g5-pool nodes with more memory. restart counts stabilized.
maria_sre: monitoring: error rate now 0.9% over 5m, latency back near baseline.
eng-maria: root cause summary draft: older SDK omitted max_tokens header for streaming; our streaming header path didn't enforce default; unbounded generation caused unbounded KV cache growth; combined with a burst of long sessions on older g4 hardware led to CUDA OOMs and container exits.
liam_oncall: logs show KV growth then OOM in sequence:
```
[18:02:11] KVCache size=0.9GB
[18:03:05] KVCache size=2.2GB
[18:03:41] KVCache size=4.6GB
[18:04:33] runtime: CUDA OOM allocating 5.2GB
```
maria_sre: mitigations executed:
- mutating webhook to set `max_tokens=1024` on missing headers for streaming (hotfix)
- Envoy per-connection token throttle rolled (canary -> full)
- +4 nodes temporary scale on decode pool and cordon/drain of problematic g4 nodes
- traffic diversion for flagged client agent to quantized fallback variant
- CS notified impacted customer with temporary mitigation details
liam_oncall: incident contained. keeping P0 open for 60m to verify stability. handing off to @sre-lead for triage and follow-ups.
sre-lead: taking over. will open postmortem ticket and track action items. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
eng-maria: follow-ups (owners): 1) runtime: add hard per-request token cap at entrypoint (eng-maria) 2) SDK: patch and release to reject/require max_tokens for streaming (product/sdk team) 3) alerting: add KVCache growth rate alert (sre-lead) 4) infra: deprecate g4dn family from streaming pool or upgrade (infra)
jon_prod: also create customer-facing post-incident note template (cs-elaine).
cs-elaine: noted, will include our mitigations and planned fixes.
maria_sre: logging timeline & attaching logs to INF ticket.
liam_oncall: leaving on-call in 10m, handoff to @sre-lead. filing INF-2026-381 for postmortem and follow-ups.
sre-lead: setting incident state to CONTAINED. will move to RESOLVED after 24h stable and completion of triage tasks.
maria_sre: final: add e2e test in CI that simulates long streaming conversation to validate KV growth bounds and SDK header handling.
liam_oncall: closing active paging. thanks all.
